prompt: Hattie races Dan around the block
title: Block Race
irony: Dan sprints to win the block race so he overshoots the finish for one more lap while Hattie plods in first and his prize turns to jogging home beside her.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Morning sun warms the corner sidewalk while Hattie squeezes orange juice and Dan laces red sneakers.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Hattie slaps the lamppost and dares Dan to race round the block while Teddy clutches dinosaur flashcards.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Frankie leans over the porch rail with a tin mic and calls the sidewalk dash like a grand final.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: Kids and neighbours crowd the curb and chant the block race chant as chalk dust puffs.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Dan sprints ahead shouting one more lap while Hattie pumps short legs and Teddy drops flashcards in the gutter.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Dan zooms past the chalk finish for an extra lap while Hattie sits on the curb and sips spilled juice through a bent straw.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The curb crowd chants the block race chant again as Hattie wipes juice and Dan circles the hydrant.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Dan stares at scuffed sneakers in the quiet studio and hears fast feet miss the fun.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Dan loosens red laces in the quiet studio and chooses to jog beside Hattie step for step.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: Under hot lamps Dan sings the turned finish line while Hattie grins and the curb crowd claps in rhythm.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: Morning sun warms the corner sidewalk again as Hattie and Dan stroll home sharing orange juice sip by sip.
